author: Brett Alan
title: Two Major Players Missing For Thursday's Game Against Dolphins - NewsBreak
text:
By Brett Alan ,
12 hours ago
With an early-in-the-week game, the injury report comes early. We found out today that two major players will be sidelined against the Dolphins.
Matt Milano will be OUT this week vs. the Dolphins It’s been one of the biggest stories of the week for the Buffalo Bills: How long will Matt Milano be out with his latest injury? Milano left the game early on Sunday against the Jets with a pectoral injury. After the game, Sean McDermott said that he got “a little dinged up” but gave a little hope later in the week, saying that he could be back to practice as early as today. However, the injury report says that he will be out against the Dolphins for Thursday night’s game.
We have no idea how long this new injury will keep Milano on the sidelines.
When Sean McDermott was asked how long he would be out this was his response:
“What I’ve been told is it’s too early until they really see how this thing settles in, if you will, or plays itself out in terms of the the days following the injury, as it relates to, I think that’ll have a direct impact on how long he’s out.” – Sean McDermott
Ed Oliver will also miss more time Oliver was one of the Bills’ biggest stars against the Ravens in week one but we haven’t seen him since that game. Unfortunately, he was stepped on during practice before the game against the Jets, and he has been out ever since. This will be his second game missed this season with that injury.
Three more players are still questionable Aside from Oliver and Milano, there are three more players who are still questionable. Nickel cornerback Taron Johnson, linebacker Shaq Thompson, and defensive back Cam Lewis are all still questionable for tomorrow night’s game.
